definitions.explanation: The process of becoming smaller, tighter, or more compact. Used for physical contraction of materials or muscles, as well as figurative shrinkage of economies or markets.

examples.japanese: {筋肉|きんにく}が{収縮|しゅうしゅく}する。
{寒|さむ}さで{金属|きんぞく}が{収縮|しゅうしゅく}した。
examples.english: The metal contracted due to the cold.

examples.japanese: {景気|けいき}の{悪化|あっか}で{市場|しじょう}が{大|おお}きく{収縮|しゅうしゅく}している。
examples.english: The market is contracting significantly due to the economic downturn.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{筋肉|きんにく}の{収縮|しゅうしゅく} (muscle contraction)
・{血管|けっかん}が{収縮|しゅうしゅく}する (blood vessels constrict)
・{経済|けいざい}の{収縮|しゅうしゅく} (economic contraction)
・{膨張|ぼうちょう}と{収縮|しゅうしゅく} (expansion and contraction)

The antonym is {膨張|ぼうちょう} (expansion). Used in scientific, medical, and economic contexts.
